description.full: One tree for the whole group and all its companies. What each company sees follows where its employees sit.
description.team: The units that have employees under them and the ones above, with their leaders and job titles.

search.label: Search the structure
search.placeholder: Search by unit name, code or a job title in it

legend.label: Colors of the unit types
legend.note: The color follows the unit type, and every card carries a text badge.

alerts.hiddenIntro: This is the structure of “{{company}}”: it shows the units that have employees of your company under them, the units above them up to the top, and the shared units that have employees.
alerts.hiddenCount: {{count}} units without employees are hidden in this view.
alerts.needFull: Seeing the full structure needs the “See the full structure” permission.
alerts.compare: You are comparing the full view with what “{{company}}” sees. The faded units with a dashed border ({{count}}) are not visible to that company's employees.
alerts.noLeader: Units with employees and no leader in their company ({{count}}):

empty.teamTitle: No units have employees of your company yet
empty.teamBody: Units show here once an employee of your company is placed in them.
empty.fullTitle: There are no units in the structure yet
empty.fullBody: Start by adding the first unit. You can review the types and their rules first from “Structure divisions”.
empty.noMatch: No units match the search or the filters

details.label: Unit details: {{name}}
details.deleteBody: The unit and its job titles are deleted if it has no units below it and no employees.

overview.sharedText: Shared: managed once from Arweqah, and the leader of the unit manages any employee under it.
overview.perCompanyText: Managed per company: each company has its own leader and employees.
overview.employeesIn: employees in {{units}} units below and {{titles}} direct titles
overview.noEmployees: There are no employees in this unit yet.
overview.ownCompanyOnly: {{count}} employees of your company. Numbers per company are in the full view.
overview.sharedNote: In a shared unit, an employee's company is written beside the name when it differs from the user's company.

node.managerHint: Optional. Offered as the direct manager of the unit's employees.
node.startHint: The day the unit started working.
node.startInvalid: Unreasonable date: from 1980 up to two years ahead.
node.effectiveHint: Today, or a later day: a change dated later is recorded as a scheduled version and applied on its day.
node.effectivePast: A change cannot start in the past.

add.title: Add a unit
add.description: Choose the parent, then the type. The allowed types follow the rules table.
add.noTypes: No unit may be created under this parent. Change the parent or edit the rules from “Structure divisions”.
add.noSlot: No code slot is free for this type under this parent.
add.parentNoCode: This parent has no code: set its code first.
add.prefixHint: Three capital English letters the codes start with, such as OPS.
add.nameEnHint: Optional. Translated from the Arabic as you type.
add.modeSharedText: Managed once from Arweqah. The leader of the unit manages any employee under it.
add.modePerCompanyText: Exists in every company, and each company has its own leader and employees.

codeNone.pending: Decided once the type is chosen

add.seesShared: It shows for every company once the first employee of any company is placed in it.
add.seesPerCompany: It will not show in a company's structure until its first employee is placed in it. Whoever can see the full structure always sees it.

changeMode.title: Change how the unit is managed
changeMode.direction: From “{{from}}” to “{{to}}”. It applies to the unit and everything under it unless one of them has its own value.
changeMode.impactToPer: Employees of the subsidiary companies in this unit change their manager from the Arweqah leader to their own company's leader, and if there is none the manager moves up inside the company. The change is audited and the reason recorded.
changeMode.impactToShared: Employees of the subsidiary companies in this unit get the Arweqah leader as their manager, and the subsidiaries' leader roles for it are closed. The change is audited and the reason recorded.
changeMode.reasonHint: For example: merging the services department into Arweqah.
changeMode.result: Changed. Units affected: {{units}}. Employees of the subsidiary companies whose manager was recomputed: {{employees}}.

setCode.title: Set the unit's code
setCode.once: This unit was created before codes existed. Its code is set once and does not change afterwards.

move.title: Move the unit
move.description: Choose a place the structure rules allow. The unit's code stays as it is.
move.nowhere: The rules allow no other place for this type.

levels.title: Structure divisions
levels.description: The unit types and the rules of who may be created under whom. One for the whole group.
levels.typesNote: Each division is one unit type for the whole group. Any division you add shows in every company.
levels.matrixNote: A tick means the child may be created under that parent. A parent accepts one type or more, and sibling units need not look alike.
levels.fixedSector: Fixed rule: a sector is created only under Arweqah Alreyadah.
levels.fixedOffice: Fixed rule: no office under an office.
levels.codeNote: The code follows the type: one slot per type (sector 1, department 2, section 3, unit 4). An office takes the number 09 in the slot where it sits, and an added division takes the unit slot.

org.title: Organization structure
org.body: The group's tree of sectors, departments, sections and units, with each unit's leader and number of employees. You see the units that have employees of your company under them and the ones above. Switch between the chart, the table and the cards, and search to reach any unit.

can.unit_create: Add a new unit to the structure
can.unit_update: Edit a unit's details and its manager
can.unit_move: Move a unit to another place in the tree
can.unit_share: Change a unit between shared and per company
can.titles: Add job titles to a unit from the “Titles” tab
can.export: Export the structure to a file

org-views.title: Ways to see the structure
org-views.body: Switch between four ways: the chart is a tree of cards, the horizontal chart is blocks side by side, the table lists every unit, and the cards. A unit's color follows its type (sector, department, section, unit, office), and each card carries a badge with the type. Click any unit to see its details.

org-full-view.title: Seeing the full structure
org-full-view.body: With your permission you see every unit, even empty ones: switch between “Employees only” and “Full view”, and choose “Show me a company's structure” to see what its employees see and what they do not.

org-levels.title: Structure divisions
org-levels.body: Here you set the unit types and their names, and the rules of who may be created under whom. The divisions are one for the whole group, and any change shows in every company.

org-add-unit.title: Add a unit
org-add-unit.body: Press here to add a unit: choose the parent and the type, write the name, and pick how it is managed (shared or per company). The code the unit will get shows before you save. In the table view, the “+” on a row adds a unit directly under it.

can.unit_update: Edit any unit and its manager from the pencil on its row
can.unit_move: Move a unit to another parent from the move button on its row

org-charter.title: Unit charter
org-charter.body: In the “Charter” tab you write the unit's purpose, its outputs, what is inside its scope and what is outside it, and its limits.

leaders.roleNote: The role «leader of {{name}}» is one role, not tied to a company. Everyone with a leader row in force holds it, and its permissions are the same in every company.
leaders.noSharedLeader: This shared unit has no leader.
leaders.sharedNote: One leader only, from the group company. They manage the employees of every company under the unit.
leaders.noLeaderAbove: No leader above for this company: the manager stays empty
leaders.noCompaniesHint: Companies appear once an employee is placed in the unit.
leaders.assign: Assign a leader or acting leader
leaders.assignTitle: Assign a leader or acting leader
leaders.sharedRule: The unit is shared: its leader is chosen from the group company only.
leaders.actingRule: An acting leader holds the leader role only for their window, and needs a leader in force for the whole window.
leaders.employeePlaceholder: Search by name or employee number
leaders.chooseCompanyFirst: Choose the company first: only its employees are listed.
leaders.validToHint: Leave empty for a leader with no end.

errors.fromPast: A leader starts today or later.
errors.toNeeded: An acting leader needs an end date.
errors.toBeforeFrom: The end cannot be before the start.
errors.endPast: The end date is today or later.

leaders.endHint: The last day they lead (today or later).
leaders.removeBody: The appointment of {{name}} is removed because it has not started yet.
leaders.jobTitleHint: The leader moves to this unit with this title from the start day, and it shows in their record.
leaders.noTitles: This unit has no active title. Add one first so the leader can take it.

charter.note: The charter says why the unit exists, what it delivers and where its work stops. Every change is recorded with its effective date and its reason in the History tab.
charter.emptyTitle: This unit has no charter yet
charter.emptyHint: The charter: purpose, outputs, what is in and out of scope, and its limits.
charter.effectiveHint: Today, or a later day to record a scheduled version.

errors.datePast: The charter cannot take effect in the past.

charter.savedScheduled: The charter is scheduled to take effect on {{date}}.

history.timeline: Versions of the unit through time
history.note: Editing the unit today does not change yesterday's record, and a unit is stopped by a date instead of being deleted. Moving it to another parent is immediate and audited.

actions.org_job_title_content_changed: A job title's content was edited
actions.org_job_titles_imported: Job titles were imported from a file
